about: Player 1 at his controller (qa_ringstage 4 + 8 + 16: he walks out of the ring, up the aisle and the ramp to the stage, and fights there -- grapples, strikes, whips) against the CPU, who follows him up. (the stagestuck agent, 2026-11-24; the user: 'CPU wrestlers are still getting stuck on stages/ramps, walking in place') qa_ringstage 1024 (arena_ringstage.c qs_measure): for the first four men, on the match clock (30 ticks a second), the ticks each spends on the ramp or the stage (past the aisle's mouth, z 530) and the ticks he WALKS IN PLACE there -- on his feet and free to walk (state 1) with a direction held for more than 10 ticks running and under 12 units from where he was 10 ticks before. state.csv lj_a the CPUs' ticks on the ramp / stage, lj_b of them in place; the game's log has a 'stagestuck:' line for each stretch (his place, buttons, the CPU's last think, the walls he was pushed off). The check: at least a CPU man-minute up there, and in place at most half a second a man-minute (lj_b x 120 <= lj_a).

expect.name: nobody's position went bad
expect.check: finite(s0_x, s0_y, s0_z, s1_x, s1_y, s1_z)

expect.name: never a stage area: the old stage view (bs_tries: the area in play)
the CPUs spent at least a man-minute on the ramp and the stage (lj_a: ticks, 30 a second)
no CPU walks in place on the ramp or the stage: at most half a second a man-minute (lj_b x 120 <= lj_a)
